trains.title: Free short skill training (PMKVY 4.0)
trains.org: Skill India, Ministry of Skill Development
trains.line: Short job-skill courses that are free for candidates, with a government certificate when you pass the assessment.
facts: Digital certificate after you pass the assessment
Aadhaar, and more than 70% attendance to sit the assessment
Register on Skill India Digital and choose a course and centre
trains.note: Courses, centres and dates change, so check the site for what is open now.

trains.title: Apprenticeship with pay (NAPS)
trains.org: Apprenticeship India, Ministry of Skill Development
trains.line: Learn on the job at a company and earn a stipend. The government shares part of the stipend with the employer.
facts: You earn a stipend paid by the employer
Freshers: 3 months of basic training, then 1 to 2 years on the job. ITI pass-outs: 1 to 2 years on the job
25% of the stipend, up to ₹1,500 a month
Aadhaar and a registration on the apprenticeship portal
trains.note: Courses, centres and dates change, so check the site for what is open now.

trains.title: Free online courses (SWAYAM)

Take a proctored exam at a centre on set dates
